reasoning_summary: Selected features prioritize stable, interpretable credit risk signals with zero missingness and broad coverage. Key credit concepts such as borrower credit quality (fico_mean), indebtedness and capacity ratios (loan_to_income, dti, revol_util), and credit exposure (total_bal_ex_mort_to_income, tot_hi_cred_lim_to_income) are included. Redundancy is controlled by preferring representative aggregates over near-duplicates (e.g., fico_mean over fico_range_low/high). Features with operational durability and clear credit meaning (e.g., term_home_ownership, purpose, addr_state) are favored. Sparse or tail-heavy variables and those with potential leakage or process contamination are avoided. The selection covers diverse semantic groups including income capacity, credit utilization, delinquency proxies, and customer history, ensuring broad semantic coverage for downstream modeling.
